content.title: HealthStream (HSTM) Earnings Growth Slows to 5%, Testing Bullish Long-Term Narratives
content.summary: HealthStream (HSTM) reported that earnings have grown by an average of 18% per year over the last five years, with net profit margins ticking up to 6.9% from 6.8% a year ago. Growth has slowed in the most recent year, with a 5% earnings increase that trails the long-term pace. Looking ahead, earnings are projected to expand at 7.7% annually, underperforming the broader US market forecast of 16% per year. Investors may find encouragement in the stock's valuation.
